lessons.title: Practice contextlib contextmanager
lessons.description: Finish opened_list, a context manager that yields a fresh list and clears that list when the block ends. The test appends 1 inside the block, checks the list equals [1] there, and checks it equals [] afterwards.
learning_objectives: This step yields the reading into the managed block, using contextlib and 2.

tests.name: test_opened_list
tests.unittest_code:
def test_opened_list(self):
    with opened_list() as items:
        items.append(1)
        self.assertEqual(items, [1])
    self.assertEqual(items, [])

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — contextlib.contextmanager — decorator for generator-based context managers

lessons.title: Practice Timing Context
lessons.description: Finish Timer so elapsed is how many seconds passed inside the with block. The test checks that elapsed is at least 0 after the block.
learning_objectives: This step shows how far the end sits past the mark, using Timer and 57.

tests.name: test_timer
tests.unittest_code:
def test_timer(self):
    with Timer() as t:
        _ = sum(range(1000))
    self.assertGreaterEqual(t.elapsed, 0.0)

lessons.title: Practice Suppress Specific Errors
lessons.description: Implement suppress(exc_type) that swallows the given exception type. The test checks that invalid input raises TypeError.
learning_objectives: This step lets the block finish when the exit asks to suppress, using Quiet holding nope.

tests.name: test_suppress
tests.unittest_code:
def test_suppress(self):
    with suppress(ValueError):
        int('x')
    with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
        with suppress(ValueError):
            raise TypeError('nope')

exercises.starter_code:
class Lock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.open = 0
    def __enter__(self):
        self.open = 1
        return self
    def __exit__(self, *args):
        self.open = 0
        return False
lock = Lock()
with lock:
    held = lock.open
held = lock.open
print(held * 24 + 24)
